instruction.text: Where else might you meet strangers? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: It is important to remember that strangers can hide their ((++identities ideas)) very easily online.
Strangers online may use the fact that they can hide their identities to try and ((++trick help)) you into thinking they are someone that they are not.
You should ((++never always)) give out personal details online.

feedback.end: It is important to never give strangers online any personal information. This includes your address, age, full name and school. You should tell a trusted adult if a stranger asks you for any of these.

atoms.a: Why should Mira not reply to the message?
b: it might cost too much money to reply
++she does not know who the person is

feedback.end: It is important to only reply to people who you know online. You should share contact details with people in person to verify their identity.

instruction.text: Rafael receives this message. His mum entered her contact details into his phone that morning.

b: ++he should wait inside the school gate
he should ignore her instructions and walk home

atoms.b: It is important to always be ((++careful reckless)) when accessing websites. Using child-friendly websites can help, but remember that strangers ((++can cannot)) use these websites too!

instruction.text: On many websites, it is possible to block and report users. Find the block button and report button to learn more.

hint.text: The two buttons you are looking for are a flag and a circle with a line through it.

feedback.finish: If somebody sends you a message that makes you uncomfortable, you can block them so they can’t contact you again. You can also report them to the website, which will notify the website’s safety team.

instruction.text: Warren, Lydia and Phoebe are playing a game on a child-friendly website. A random user sends them a message that they find upsetting.

b: They should carry on playing and ignore it.
++They could report the user to alert the website’s safety team.
They could message the user and explain why it upset them.

feedback.wrong: It is important to remember not to contact people that you do not know online.

atoms.a: They have blocked and reported the user. Should they still tell an adult about it?
b: No, they should not tell an adult.
